title: The Rising Draft Course
summary: A course that teaches the student to lift a foe or the self on a rising current and to strike from the height gained.

title: The Cutting Wind Companion
summary: A companion to the basic gust work that thins the air to an edge and teaches the student to slice and parry with it.

title: A Treatise on Cleansing Air
summary: A treatise on driving smoke and fume and taint out of the air and out of an ally's lungs by means of a clean current.

title: Manual of the Swift Glide
summary: A manual of long low glides that teaches the student to cross ground fast on moving air and strike without stopping.

title: The Turning Gale Course
summary: A course on turning a foe's force aside with a spinning current and sending it back at the foe in the same motion.

title: Handbook of the Listening Wind
summary: A handbook for scouts and sentries on carrying sound and scent on the wind and on quieting the air about one's own steps.

title: The Whirl and Shear Course
summary: A course that joins a spinning body to a shearing edge of air so that one turn guards and cuts at once.

title: A Course in Binding Currents
summary: A course in tying a foe's limbs and weapon with ropes of moving air and holding them there until the student acts.
